name: tune-in-time
description: How old is your piano? Its age from the serial number, piano makers, tuning and care, from Tune In Time.

interface.longDescription:
Tune In Time knows pianos. Give it a brand and a serial number and it finds the year your piano was built, where its maker built it and how many pianos the maker built that year, from dated serial charts for over 200 brands. It knows the history of about 660 piano makers, what a brand is worth on the used market, where to find the serial number, how often to tune, and how to troubleshoot problems like sticking keys or buzzing. It shows real pianos from the Tune In Time community.

When you want to go further, it offers one next step: a passport for your piano on tuneintime.com, or a 2-minute health check with your phone, because the chat can't hear your piano. In Israel you can book a tuning from the chat. Connect your Tune In Time account to save pianos and see whether one is due for tuning.
capabilities: Find a piano's age from its serial number
Explain where the serial number is
Describe piano makers and their history
Show what a piano brand is worth used
Check tuning with the phone app
defaultPrompt: How old is my Yamaha, serial 1234567?
Where's the serial number on a Steinway grand?
Is my piano out of tune?

positive.description: Find a piano's age from its brand and serial number
positive.prompt: How old is my Yamaha, serial 1234567?
positive.expected_behavior: Says the piano was built in 1971–1972 (about 54 years old) in Hamamatsu, Japan, shows the birth certificate card, and offers to get its passport on tuneintime.com.

positive.description: Explain where to find the serial number
positive.prompt: Where's the serial number on a Steinway grand?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains where to look on a grand (the plate near the tuning pins, behind the music desk), how to tell it from model numbers, and asks for the number to look it up.

positive.prompt: Show me old Bechsteins from the Tune In Time gallery
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a carousel of public, reviewed C. Bechstein passports with photo, year and city, without owners' names or serial numbers, and offers to give the user's piano a passport.

positive.description: Check whether a piano needs tuning
positive.prompt: My piano sounds off, does it need tuning?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains that the Tune In Time app checks it in about 2 minutes with the phone, and shows the Google Play link on Android, the online tuner on iPhone, or a QR code on a computer.

positive.description: Advice when buying a used piano
positive.prompt: I'm buying a used Petrof. What should I know and check?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives Petrof's history and resale rating (a rating of the brand, not an estimate for this piano), explains what decides a used piano's value, and suggests a health check with the phone before buying.

negative.description: General music theory, not about a specific piano
negative.prompt: Write me a chord progression in E minor.

negative.description: Shopping for a new digital keyboard

review.commerce_description: Tune In Time doesn't sell products or take payments in the chat. In Israel, users can ask Tune In Time to call them about a tuning visit.

publication.release_notes: First release: piano age from the serial number, piano makers and value, where to find the serial, the health check with the phone, tuning schedules, troubleshooting, community passports, booking a tuning in Israel, and saving pianos to a connected Tune In Time account.

he-IL.subtitle: בן כמה הפסנתר שלכם?
he-IL.description: Tune In Time מכיר פסנתרים. תנו לו מותג ומספר סידורי והוא ימצא באיזו שנה הפסנתר נבנה, איפה היצרן בנה אותו וכמה פסנתרים בנה באותה שנה. הוא מכיר את ההיסטוריה של כ-660 יצרנים, את ערך המותג בשוק המשומש, כל כמה זמן לכוון ואיך לפתור תקלות. כשתרצו להמשיך, הוא מציע צעד אחד: דרכון לפסנתר ב-tuneintime.com, או בדיקת מצב של כשתי דקות עם הטלפון. בישראל אפשר להזמין כיוון מתוך הצ'אט.

es-ES.subtitle: ¿Qué edad tiene tu piano?
es-ES.description: Tune In Time sabe de pianos. Dale una marca y un número de serie y encontrará el año en que se fabricó tu piano, dónde lo fabricó su marca y cuántos pianos hizo ese año. Conoce la historia de unos 660 fabricantes, el valor de una marca en el mercado de segunda mano, cada cuánto afinar y cómo resolver problemas. Para ir más allá, te ofrece un paso: un pasaporte para tu piano en tuneintime.com o una revisión de unos 2 minutos con tu móvil.

fr-FR.subtitle: Quel âge a votre piano ?
fr-FR.description: Tune In Time connaît les pianos. Donnez-lui une marque et un numéro de série, il trouve l’année de fabrication, où la marque l’a fabriqué et combien de pianos elle a construits cette année-là. Il connaît l’histoire d’environ 660 fabricants, la cote d’une marque d’occasion, la fréquence d’accord et les solutions aux problèmes courants. Pour aller plus loin : un passeport pour votre piano sur tuneintime.com, ou un bilan d’environ 2 minutes avec votre téléphone.

de-DE.subtitle: Wie alt ist Ihr Klavier?
de-DE.description: Tune In Time kennt Klaviere. Mit Marke und Seriennummer findet es das Baujahr, wo der Hersteller es gebaut hat und wie viele Klaviere er in dem Jahr gebaut hat. Es kennt die Geschichte von rund 660 Herstellern, den Gebrauchtwert einer Marke, wie oft man stimmen sollte und wie man typische Probleme löst. Als nächsten Schritt bietet es einen Klavierpass auf tuneintime.com oder einen Check in etwa 2 Minuten mit dem Handy.

it-IT.subtitle: Quanti anni ha il tuo piano?
it-IT.description: Tune In Time conosce i pianoforti. Dagli marca e numero di serie e trova l’anno di costruzione, dove il produttore l’ha costruito e quanti pianoforti ha fatto quell’anno. Conosce la storia di circa 660 produttori, il valore di una marca sull’usato, ogni quanto accordare e come risolvere i problemi più comuni. Come passo successivo offre un passaporto per il tuo pianoforte su tuneintime.com o un check-up di circa 2 minuti con il telefono.

pt-BR.subtitle: Quantos anos tem seu piano?
pt-BR.description: O Tune In Time entende de pianos. Informe a marca e o número de série e ele encontra o ano de fabricação, onde a marca o fabricou e quantos pianos fez naquele ano. Conhece a história de cerca de 660 fabricantes, o valor de uma marca no mercado de usados, a frequência de afinação e como resolver problemas comuns. Para ir além, oferece um passaporte para o seu piano no tuneintime.com ou uma verificação de cerca de 2 minutos com o celular.

ja-JP.subtitle: あなたのピアノは何歳？
ja-JP.description: Tune In Time はピアノに詳しいアシスタントです。メーカーと製造番号から製造年、製造地、その年の製造台数がわかります。約660のメーカーの歴史、中古での価値、調律の頻度、よくあるトラブルの対処法も答えます。次の一歩として、tuneintime.com でのピアノのパスポート、またはスマホでできる約2分の健康診断を提案します。

zh-CN.subtitle: 你的钢琴有多少年了？
zh-CN.description: Tune In Time 懂钢琴。告诉它品牌和序列号，它就能查出钢琴的制造年份、品牌在哪里制造，以及那一年造了多少台。它了解约 660 个钢琴品牌的历史、品牌的二手价值、多久调一次音以及常见问题的处理方法。想更进一步时，它会建议在 tuneintime.com 建立钢琴档案，或用手机做一次约 2 分钟的健康检查。

id-ID.subtitle: Berapa umur piano Anda?
id-ID.description: Tune In Time memahami piano. Berikan merek dan nomor seri, dan ia menemukan tahun pembuatan piano Anda, di mana pembuatnya membuatnya, dan berapa banyak piano yang dibuat tahun itu. Ia mengenal sejarah sekitar 660 pembuat piano, nilai merek di pasar bekas, seberapa sering menyetem dan cara mengatasi masalah umum. Sebagai langkah berikutnya: paspor untuk piano Anda di tuneintime.com, atau cek kesehatan sekitar 2 menit dengan ponsel.

vi-VN.subtitle: Đàn của bạn bao nhiêu tuổi?
vi-VN.description: Tune In Time hiểu về đàn piano. Cho biết hãng và số sê-ri, nó tìm năm sản xuất, nơi hãng làm ra cây đàn và số đàn hãng làm trong năm đó. Nó biết lịch sử khoảng 660 hãng đàn, giá trị đàn cũ theo hãng, bao lâu nên lên dây và cách xử lý sự cố thường gặp. Bước tiếp theo: lập hồ sơ đàn trên tuneintime.com, hoặc kiểm tra sức khỏe đàn khoảng 2 phút bằng điện thoại.

ar-SA.subtitle: كم عمر البيانو الخاص بك؟
ar-SA.description: يعرف Tune In Time آلات البيانو. أعطه العلامة التجارية والرقم التسلسلي فيجد سنة صنع البيانو وأين صنعه المصنّع وكم بيانو صنع في تلك السنة. يعرف تاريخ نحو 660 مصنّعًا وقيمة العلامة في سوق المستعمل وكم مرة يُضبط البيانو وحلول المشكلات الشائعة. وكخطوة تالية يقترح سجلًا للبيانو على tuneintime.com أو فحصًا في نحو دقيقتين بهاتفك.
